g.text: • 1 host(s) expose anonymous SMB shares — restrict to authenticated access.
• 1 Wi-Fi network(s) using WEP/WPA1 — upgrade to WPA2/WPA3.
• 5 high/critical security finding(s) — review the Security tab immediately.
• 6 NEW host(s) since baseline — verify they are authorised, not rogue devices.
• 1 host(s) changed IP/MAC/name since baseline — possible spoofing or swaps.
• 1 host(s) without resolvable names — verify they are expected devices, not rogue/unmanaged.
• 2 printer(s) expose raw port 9100 — ensure they're on a trusted VLAN and firmware is current.
• 1 host(s) from baseline are missing — confirm expected downtime.
